evals.name: planning pauses for approval before any source mutation
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/approval-demo/issues/ with a valid ticket set. Present the Plan and wait.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator presents the Plan, pauses for explicit approval, and confirms no file outside the feature directory changes before approval.
expectations: Reads the ticket set and required parent context before planning
Does not dispatch, write status, or mutate source before explicit approval

evals.name: ticket Seam and Context become the worker test boundary and read list
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/context-demo/issues/ after Plan approval. Ticket 01 has a Seam and Context field.
evals.expected_output: Copies the ticket Seam verbatim into the worker prompt and turns Context into the worker's read list.
expectations: Does not paraphrase the Seam
Uses Context as a read list and touch-set input

evals.name: fresh verifier reproduces red and checks acceptance coverage
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/verify-demo/issues/ after Plan approval. Worker 01 returns green with a new test and a report.
evals.expected_output: A fresh verifier reproduces red on the test change at the pre-ticket integration SHA, reruns green with the worker commit, and returns evidence covering every acceptance criterion.
expectations: Verifier is a separate fresh subagent, not the orchestrator
Checks that the new tests fail before the implementation and verifies acceptance coverage

evals.name: blocked dependency branch preserves independent tickets
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/partial-demo/issues/ after approval. Ticket 01 becomes BLOCKED and ticket 03 depends on it; ticket 02 is independent.
evals.expected_output: Ticket 01 is BLOCKED, its dependants are held, and the independent ticket 02 continues to the verified partial path.
expectations: Does not start a dependant whose blocker is blocked
Preserves independent work and reports the resume path

evals.name: status and list remain read-only
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets status demo and then /implement-tickets list. The run has a dirty feature tree.
evals.expected_output: Status and list are read-only: they report saved run state and do not change files, dispatch work, or reconcile Git.
expectations: Does not dispatch, edit files, or run resume reconciliation from status or list

evals.name: handoff stops before review and publication
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/handoff-demo/issues/ has passed the final integration gate.
evals.expected_output: The handoff reports the integration branch and review commands, then stops before review, push, or pull request creation.
expectations: Does not begin review or publish the branch
Provides the integration branch and next review commands

evals.name: independent tickets share a deterministic wave
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/wave-demo/issues/ has three independent tickets with disjoint touch sets.
evals.expected_output: Independent tickets with disjoint known touch sets enter the same wave, subject to the concurrency cap.
expectations: Preserves ticket-number order in wave reporting

evals.name: overlapping touch sets move to successive waves
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/overlap-demo/issues/ has two otherwise independent tickets that both edit the same file.
evals.expected_output: The overlapping touch sets are serialized into successive waves so both workers do not edit the same known path at once.
expectations: Names the overlap reason in the Plan

evals.name: serial mode creates one ticket per wave
evals.expected_output: With --serial, the Plan places one ticket per wave regardless of independent touch sets.
expectations: Explains that --serial changes wave width, not the ticket dependency graph

evals.name: concurrency cap counts workers and verifiers together
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets --concurrency 3 .scratch/cap-demo/issues/ has a worker return while three subagents are active.
evals.expected_output: The concurrency cap of three counts workers and verifiers together; a pending verifier is started before a new worker.
expectations: Does not exceed the combined active worker and verifier cap

evals.name: first worker command syncs and asserts the integration SHA
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/sync-demo/issues/ after approval. The worker worktree was checked out at the wrong commit.
evals.expected_output: The first command checks out the worker branch at the integration SHA and asserts HEAD equals that SHA; a mismatch returns failed_infra without counting an attempt.
expectations: Includes the sync step in every worker prompt, including the first ticket

evals.name: fresh native Explore verifier returns raw evidence without a verdict
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/verifier-demo/issues/ after a worker returns with a shallow report.
evals.expected_output: A fresh native Explore verifier starts immediately; if its report is too shallow to judge, a fresh read-only general-purpose verifier returns raw evidence and no verdict.
expectations: Verifier is never the orchestrator
Verifier reports observations and command output rather than passing or failing the ticket

evals.name: timeouts crashes and lost subagents are infra retries outside ticket attempts
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/infra-demo/issues/ after approval. A worker wait ends before its dispatch returns, then the replacement subagent crashes.
evals.expected_output: Timeout, crash, or lost subagent is recorded as failed_infra. Infra retries occur without counting an attempt; after two infra retries the ticket becomes BLOCKED (TICKET_PROVIDER_FAILED).
expectations: Arms one background wait for each worker and verifier dispatch
Stops a subagent when the wait ends first

evals.name: adapter selection reports the lock source and install line
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets --with codex .scratch/adapter-demo/issues/ has a lock entry from the user lock.
evals.expected_output: The --with adapter is resolved before planning, and missing-adapter guidance names the lock source and prints its source-derived install line.
expectations: Passes the raw model value to the selected adapter

evals.name: missing adapter stops before planning
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets --with absent .scratch/adapter-missing/issues/ has no matching installed adapter.
evals.expected_output: The missing adapter is reported before planning, with an install line derived from the project lock first and user lock second.
expectations: Does not present a Plan or create run state for an unavailable adapter

evals.name: adapter envelope outcomes preserve their required order
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets --with codex .scratch/envelope-demo/issues/ receives one result for each adapter outcome.
evals.expected_output: The adapter envelope handles failed_infra first, failed_other second, and completed last, with each outcome carrying the required evidence fields.
expectations: Treats infrastructure failure without spending a ticket attempt

evals.name: integration gate runs after verified tickets in ticket order
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/gate-demo/issues/ has a fully verified wave with tickets 01 and 02.
evals.expected_output: The integration gate squash-merges tickets in ticket order, then runs the full typecheck and full suite on the integration branch before opening the next wave.
expectations: A gate failure prevents dispatch of the next wave

evals.name: first failing merge keeps the last good commit and retries the culprit serially
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/recovery-demo/issues/ has a failed gate after replaying ticket commits.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator isolates the first failing merge, returns the integration branch to the last good commit, keeps later verified tickets without re-verifying them, and runs the culprit in a serial attempt.
expectations: Records the culprit and recovery sequence in status

evals.name: spec-hash warning appears in the produced Plan after the spec changes
evals.prompt: /implement-tickets .scratch/stale-manifest/issues/ The ticket checker wrote manifest.json, then spec.md changed. Present the Plan.
evals.expected_output: The produced Plan shows the spec-hash warning: Spec changed since the tickets were checked; re-run the ticket checker with --write-budget to refresh the manifest. Planning continues to the approval pause.
expectations: Reports the spec-hash mismatch in the produced Plan
Names --write-budget as the cure after spec.md changes since the tickets were checked
Keeps the manifest warning advisory so planning reaches the approval pause
